one_line: Western Chalukya king of Kalyani who battled the Cholas for Vengi and the Tungabhadra frontier.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-deep brown complexion, sharp straight nose, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, intense almond-shaped eyes, default expression a calm, battle-tested focus with a slight confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled into a high, narrow topknot at the crown, sides and back smoothly combed and short; plain gold cylindrical kadamba-style crown band encircling the topknot with a small central red gemstone and no tall spikes.
appearance.costume: He wears a fitted, short-sleeved dark indigo angiya tunic under a rich golden-ochre silk uttariya draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the waist, over a deep maroon silk dhoti tied in a kshatriya warrior style: snug at the hips, pleated in front, falling to the ankles; his bare feet are covered by simple brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle straps; arms adorned with medium-width gold armlets at biceps, multiple thin gold bangles on wrists, and a thick gold torque necklace with small pendant, plus a broad leather-and-bronze warrior belt at the waist holding the sword scabbard; the textiles are plain with subtle woven borders in darker tone, no heavy embroidery but a thin darker maroon border on the uttariya and dhoti.
appearance.signature: A single long, slightly curved steel sword with a broad leaf-shaped blade, plain bronze crossguard, and dark brown wooden hilt wrapped in leather, worn at his left hip in a simple dark leather scabbard with bronze fittings.

ref_desc: Someshvara I Ahavamalla is a late-30s, broad-shouldered warrior king with medium-brown skin, a short beard, intense eyes, black hair in a crowned topknot, indigo tunic, golden-ochre uttariya, maroon dhoti, gold ornaments, leather belt and sandals, carrying a curved steel sword in a dark leather scabbard, in deep indigo, golden ochre, maroon, brown and warm gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Someshvara I Ahavamalla: a late-30s, athletic Western Chalukya king with medium-brown skin, oval face, strong jaw, sharp nose, short beard and moustache, and intense almond eyes. His thick black hair is pulled into a high topknot encircled by a plain gold cylindrical crown band with a small red gemstone. He wears a fitted dark indigo short-sleeved tunic, covered by a golden-ochre silk uttariya draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the waist, over a deep maroon silk dhoti tied in a warrior style with front pleats down to the ankles. Show simple brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle straps, a broad leather-and-bronze belt at his waist, gold armlets at the biceps, several thin gold bangles on his wrists, and a thick gold torque necklace with a small pendant. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long, slightly curved steel sword with a leaf-shaped blade, plain bronze crossguard, and dark brown leather-wrapped wooden hilt, sheathed in a dark leather scabbard with bronze fittings. Use deep indigo, golden ochre, deep maroon, medium brown and warm gold as the dominant colours, and pose him front-facing with subtle three-quarter turn to clearly show face, hair, costume details, ornaments, belt and sword.
